topview_scene_intake.rule: Scene ID is the creative scene; task ID is one render/slot. Capacity is 6 active task IDs. Canonical slow_scenes stays unique by Scene ID, while the Control Center shows one row per active task/slot.

note: Fresh 7/7 Drive↔GitHub comparison after Topview/sync incident; certificate refreshed so stale verification is not confused with an authoritative sync failure.

recovery_sync.note: Daily deep audit runs inside hourly Recovery when due; Topview Scene Intake & Slow Watch remains separate.

service_files_ui.note: Seven instructions are shown vertically 1-7; project-data links are separate and are not additional instructions.

slow_table_ui.rule: All three user-facing views render from one normalized topview-status active_tasks snapshot. Revision shows unique scenes/tasks, Topview table is one row per task, active-scene map is one row per Scene with multiplicity. Queue/status values must never come from independent caches.

site_filters.singleton_policy: hide scene-specific singleton filters unless they have explicit owner/workflow value
site_filters.rule: After active scene or scene-meta tag changes, audit tag frequency, duplicates/synonyms, overlap with state/engine/dialogue/dependencies/slow, Russian labels, stale filters, and missing useful scene types.
site_filters.note: After Scene 22, space_battle and first_last_frame/seamless_transition are present in two active scenes (21,22), so they are now useful Russian filters rather than scene-specific singleton tags.

topview_liveness.owner_experience: set-and-forget; deterministic telemetry drift repaired automatically
topview_liveness.note: Both automations start exact hourly at HH:00:00 Europe/Moscow; Recovery must not race an in-progress healthy watcher cycle at the shared boundary.

views: 🎬 Активные сцены проекта — карта и навигация
three_view_topview_contract.summary_cardinality: unique Scene IDs plus explicit active-task multiplicity
three_view_topview_contract.scene_map_cardinality: one row per unique active Scene ID with aggregated live status
three_view_topview_contract.queue_source: exact active_tasks[].queue_count per task; never cached or scene-level substitute for multi-task scenes
required_equalities: unique(active_tasks.scene_id) == project-status.slow_scenes == canonical slow Scene IDs
occupied_slots == len(active_tasks) == Topview table row count
per-scene multiplicity == count(active_tasks for that scene)
three_view_topview_contract.failure_behavior: non-green; deterministic automatic repair by watcher/recovery; owner must not manually reconcile

hourly_topview_publication.recovery_watchdog: AI Film Recovery Sync exact hourly at HH:00:00 Europe/Moscow
required_every_successful_run: fresh provider telemetry refresh for every active task
fresh topview-status.json commit even for queue/status/ETA-only changes
one checked_at for the whole snapshot
all three Control Center views rendered from the same active_tasks[] snapshot
Pages/public snapshot not knowingly left older than successful telemetry refresh
three_views: 🎬 Активные сцены проекта — карта и навигация
hourly_topview_publication.failure_behavior: watcher run incomplete/non-green; Recovery performs one deterministic repair attempt; owner is not asked to reconcile manually

chatgpt_project_mode.role: context container / continuity layer, not authority
chatgpt_project_mode.bootstrap: Project context first, then canonical takeover/preflight; fresh-read live authority before writes
chatgpt_project_mode.chat_vs_work: ordinary creative scene work may use Project Chat; long multi-step technical/audit/recovery work should prefer Work inside the same Project
chatgpt_project_mode.static_copy_rule: stale/generated copies in old chats or Project attachments never override accessible live Drive/GitHub
chatgpt_project_mode.owner_experience: new chats continue from current state; do not ask owner to restate known facts or manually perform deterministic infrastructure work

automation_schedule.one_writer_note: Topview watcher remains primary writer; Recovery must not race a healthy/current watcher cycle at the shared hour boundary.

library_recovery.owner_interruption_policy: do_not_prompt_owner_for_routine_library_overwrite; skip and mark pending/stale if interactive consent is required
library_recovery.retry: Recovery/deep audit may retry only when no new interactive confirmation is required
library_recovery.truth_rule: Never claim Library current without successful write/read-back; authoritative layers remain Drive/GitHub; Notion remains operational/story pointer.
